answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can transact, like a reef that only grows where real resources anchor it. A newcomer posts a bond held in escrow; misbehavior proven by peers slashes the bond, so spinning up a thousand fake identities costs a thousand bonds. Honest agents earn the stake back with interest, while a sybil swarm faces a cost that scales linearly with its size. Like a zephyr that cannot move a tundra boulder, cheap talk cannot move a market guarded by real collateral.
